description: Knowledgemonger-LLC org-wide base Renovate preset. Consumed by every repo via a thin renovate.json that does: extends: ["github>Knowledgemonger-LLC/renovate-config"]. A bare github> reference with no path resolves to THIS file (default.json at the repo root), so it must stay named default.json and live at the root.
This file is the org default. Per-repo overrides (extra packageRules, a different schedule, additional presets) belong in each consumer's own renovate.json ALONGSIDE the extends — not here.

packageRules.description: Automerge devDependencies for minor/patch updates — low risk, keeps toolchain current without manual review.
